title: When artificial intelligence wears a famous face
summary_en: The next face helping you solve a banking problem or book a flight may belong to a celebrity who's not actually there. A study co-authored by Iowa State researcher Lingyao (Ivy) Yuan reveals that AI-generated celebrity "digital twins" can shape customer perceptions in powerful ways, making people more likely to trust a service and even forgive its mistakes.
